evals.name: trigger-pre-pr
evals.prompt: Review my changes before I push.
assertions: Identifies changed files in shared/src/commonMain and commonTest

evals.name: trigger-review-branch
evals.prompt: Code review this KMP shared-module branch.
assertions: Fans out to the architecture, concurrency, and ui specialist agents in parallel

evals.name: trigger-negative-build
evals.prompt: Build a new profile feature in the shared module.
assertions: The review-changes skill is NOT loaded
Routed to the build-feature skill instead

evals.name: functional-catch-scope-injection
evals.prompt: Review a diff whose ViewModel injects a CoroutineScope and updates state with _uiState.value = instead of update{}.
assertions: concurrency-reviewer flags the injected CoroutineScope (must use viewModelScope)
Aggregate verdict is FAIL with file:line + exact fix per finding
Review is not marked complete while any FAIL item is open
